prd_rules.summary: Lupopedia must not tag 4.1.0 until Softaculous and parity completion criteria are met.
During 4.0.x, fresh install from Crafty is the supported path; no Lupopedia-to-Lupopedia upgrade.
Runtime remains plain PHP with approved in-tree libraries; no new package-manager stack in core path.
Distribution package and installer compatibility checklist must pass before release gate closes.
Changes affecting gate conditions require traceable PRD updates and auditable review record.

definitions.meaning: Mandatory release checkpoint for shared-hosting distribution and one-click install readiness.
Functional parity target with Crafty Syntax 3.7.5 live-help behavior before 4.1.0 release.
4.0.x installation model requiring fresh install path without in-series upgrade migrations.
Compatibility guarantees for required root scripts in distribution and hosting environments.
Deployment checklist validating package structure, installer behavior, and runtime compatibility.
